description: Pulse concentrator (2 S0 inputs, up to 3 VMU-OC input modules) with RS-485 Modbus RTU
source: Carlo Gavazzi, VMU-MC communication protocol, version 1 revision 2 (2018-02-15)
notes: FC03 and FC04 return the same values; settings are written with FC06 or FC16.
32-bit values are sent low word first.
Totalizers are raw counts: the decimal point and base unit registers say how to read them (they are only for interpretation; the device does not apply them).
VMU-OC totalizers only have values when the corresponding input module is connected and configured.
